idea-plugin.name: Env Data Sources
idea-plugin.description:
Creates IDE database connections from your project's .env file — no manual setup of host, port, user and password for every project and every service.

On project open the plugin reads .env and creates one data source per group of keys. Keys named DB_<GROUP>_<FIELD> become separate data sources, while missing fields (host, port, driver) are inherited from the base DB_* set — so a typical Laravel .env with several connections yields several ready-to-use data sources.

  • Re-syncs when .env changes; connections are matched by a marker property, so they are updated instead of duplicated.
  • Connections you created by hand are never touched.
  • Passwords go to the IDE password store, not to dataSources.xml.
  • Supports MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle and ClickHouse, including Doctrine-style aliases such as pdo_mysql.
  • Manual run: Tools | Sync Data Sources from .env. Settings: Settings | Tools | Env Data Sources.

Requires the bundled Database Tools and SQL plugin (included in PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and other paid IDEs).
